findings: Coinbase publicly offers USDC borrowing against XRP through Morpho on Base, with a stated maximum of $100K against XRP for eligible customers.
Coinbase Global Exchange separately accepts XRP as cross-collateral for perpetual futures, subject to average-daily-quantity portfolio limits.
Coinbase's collateral recovery documentation identifies cbXRP on Base as the XRP representation used for collateral operations.
These are verified product capabilities, not evidence of actual XRP loan utilization, posted collateral balances or net XRP purchases.
Native XRPL LendingProtocol/SingleAssetVault remains inactive; Coinbase/Morpho and Coinbase Global Exchange are external collateral channels.
